parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:

the keys valid at a point.

- `rating__`  -  minimum rating, 0 - 5 with one decimal (`rating__4` keeps vendors rated 4.0 or more)
- `delivery_time__`  -  vendors whose ETA range starts at N minutes or less; the upper end is not bounded
- `price_categories__-`  -  a band from `/listing-filters` `price_bands` (`price_categories__0-50.00`) or a custom one (`price_categories__20-40`); the minimum must be below the maximum
- toggles from `/listing-filters` `filters`: `is_top__true`, `is_new__true`, `offers_all__true`, `subscription_only__true` (HungerStation Plus vendors)

Toggles must all match, several price bands match any, and `filters` combines with `cuisine_ids` by AND. An
unknown key answers 400 naming the accepted ones. With `filters`, `total_count` is `null` and a page can come
back short or empty while `has_more` is `true`  -  keep paging.
